strings.name: Ana Botín
strings.summary: Born in Santander, Botín studied economics and worked in New York banking before joining Santander in 1988. She led Banesto and the UK business, then became group executive chair after her father’s death in 2014. She advanced retail banking and digital services across Europe and the Americas and held leadership roles in international finance associations.
